title: FATE in AI: Towards Algorithmic Inclusivity and Accessibility

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing local community definitions of regional terms (e.g., the Hausa words 'boko' and 'dan-boko') with the outputs of AI search engines and text generation models to demonstrate reliance on unrepresentative training data and the amplification of negative cultural stereotypes.

Conducting a user study to evaluate how different levels of educational qualification and digital literacy impact users' perceptions of algorithmic transparency, recommendation relevance, and trust in AI-driven social media advertisements.
